Hi Michele,

Thank you so much for your message. I truly appreciate you taking the time to reach out, and I want you to know how excited I am to be working with you. I’m really looking forward to supporting you and helping you move forward in a way that feels aligned, sustainable, and successful.

I also wanted to share on a personal note that I’ve gone through neck surgery myself, so I genuinely understand how challenging that process can be. It’s not just physical, it can impact your day-to-day life, your energy, and even how you show up in your work. Because of that, I have a lot of empathy for what you’re navigating, and I want you to know that I will always approach our work together with that understanding in mind.

As we move forward, my goal is to make this as supportive and seamless for you as possible while still helping you achieve meaningful progress. We’ll take things step by step and ensure everything we implement feels manageable and effective for you and your team.

I’m truly looking forward to what we’re going to build together and am grateful for the opportunity to partner with you.

Warmly,  
Bethany
